knownFailures.step: a relay stays connected while the object hibernates, and a tool call wakes it
knownFailures.note: WebSocket hibernation is not available on Rivet 3. Orange emulates it: it drops the idle object and keeps its sockets open, but the Rivet actor does not sleep while a socket is open. This step waits for every actor to sleep, so it fails with: Some actor was still awake.
